panels.description: Full-page mine-regulator climax. Alex and Bi11bot wrench the manual wheel open together; their joined effort is central. A broad cold-water surge erupts toward Keel. Alex drops to one knee but keeps one hand on the wheel. Bi11bot anchors against the rail, rounded and protective without menace. The awakened white-and-amber node is a secondary focal point. Leave upper-left open for dialogue and lower water channel open for the SFX.
